page_title: HEI 3-2 BAY | Heidenheim v Bayern Munich 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A quickly taken corner by Heidenheim.
90+4' Dangerous play by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich). Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Eren Dinkci.
90+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
87' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
84' Here comes a substitution. Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Thomas Muller.
83' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Leon Goretzka will be replaced by Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich).

83' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Kevin Muller, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
79' 3 - 2 Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) for Jamal Musiala.
76' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
76' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Jan-Niklas Beste and he is replaced by Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
75' Robert Schroder blows for a foul after Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Heidenheim.
73' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
73' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is about to take a corner kick.
69' That was close by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
68' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Kevin Muller anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
67' Here's the change. Serge Gnabry leaves the pitch and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes on as a substitute.
67' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
66' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
62' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
61' Referee Robert Schroder halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Thomas Tuchel, then shows him a yellow.
59' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is flagged for offside.
58' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

56' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Kevin Muller has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

51' 2 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
51' 1 - 2 Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Frank Schmidt probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Adrian Beck (Heidenheim). He is replaced by Marvin Pieringer.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a half-time substitution. Kevin Sessa comes on in place of Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim).
46' Half-time substitution. Frank Schmidt decided to make a change. Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) is replaced by Marnon Busch.
46' Referee Robert Schroder blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

45' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) makes it 0:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Alphonso Davies and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Kevin Muller was helpless.
41' Referee Robert Schroder points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) goes wild in celebration.
39' The Bayern Munich players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Schroder makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
38' 0 - 1 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
35' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
31' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
30' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
28' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Robert Schroder who sees an offensive foul.
28' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.
27' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
27' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
26' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
24' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
23' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) makes a slide tackle, but referee Robert Schroder blows for a foul.
22' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
21' The ball is cleared after Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
20' This shall not pass! Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
18' Some great controlled play and passing from Bayern Munich. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
14' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
12' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
12' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

11' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Heidenheim earn a corner.
10' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
8' Robert Schroder couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) and blew his whistle.
6' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) picks up a long through ball, but Kevin Muller deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
6' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
4' Bayern Munich keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
3' A pass by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Schroder.
